scalars.scalar_value: Experience with academic advising, educational planning, transcript review, degree audits, or enrollment services.
Experience working in a California Community College or higher education environment.

items.item_text: For questions regarding this position, please contact the Human Resources Department at hr@frc.edu .
Visa Sponsorship
H1B1 visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
Possession of, or ability to obtain, a valid California driver’s license and satisfactory driving record.
Experience with academic advising, educational planning, transcript review, degree audits, or enrollment services.
Experience working in a California Community College or higher education environment.
Experience utilizing Banner or similar student information systems.
Experience working with justice-impacted, incarcerated, formerly incarcerated, or justice impacted student populations.
Experience supporting correspondence education, distance education, or restricted-access instructional programs.
Experience working with federal, state, institutional, or grant-funded program requirements.
DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERISTICS:
Provide academic advising support, educational planning assistance, enrollment guidance, and student support services to Rising Scholars students.
Assist students in understanding educational goals, degree and certificate requirements, transfer pathways, academic expectations, and available student support resources.
Assist students with accessing admissions, registration, enrollment, records, financial aid, and other institutional processes.
Develop, update, and maintain Student Education Plans.
Maintain accurate student records, advising notes, documentation, correspondence, and program-related information.
Review transcripts, academic records, degree progress information, prerequisites, and enrollment information to support student educational planning.
Assist with enrollment, registration, roster, grade, census, and student record processes to support accurate and timely student information.

Use Banner (FRC’s student information system) and related student information systems to access, update, maintain, and review student information in accordance with established procedures, including auditing student academic records to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of enrollment, academic standing, transfer credit, and graduation information.
Review instructor class rosters, enrollment transactions, census rosters, final grades, and related records to ensure accuracy and compliance with District procedures.
Interpret and explain institutional policies, procedures, deadlines, FERPA requirements, Title 5 regulations, and program guidelines related to assigned student support responsibilities.
Provide individual and group advising, orientations, information sessions,
Correspond with students to support engagement, persistence, retention, and completion.
Communicate with faculty, Admissions and Records, Financial Aid, Student Services departments, correctional education partners, and other stakeholders.
Compile, track, monitor, and prepare reports related to student participation in the program, enrollment, advising activities, and assigned program responsibilities.
Assist with student orientations, and educational support services for justice-impacted students.
Assist in managing incoming phone calls and written student inquires.
Participate in meetings, trainings, professional development activities, committees, and shared governance activities as assigned. May assign and review the work of student employees.
Perform related duties as assigned.
Principles and practices of academic advising, student support services, outreach, retention, and student success programs.
California Community College admissions, registration, enrollment, records, transfer, and educational planning processes.
Degree, certificate, general education, graduation, and transfer requirements.
Student information systems (such as Banner) databases, electronic records management, and reporting practices.
FERPA, confidentiality requirements, and applicable institutional policies governing student records.
Title 5 regulations and procedures related to assigned student support responsibilities.
Student support strategies for diverse, nontraditional, and historically underserved student populations.
Principles of culturally responsive communication and equitable student engagement.
Processes related to restricted-access educational environments, correspondence education, and distance education.
Standard office software, databases, spreadsheets, and communication systems.
Establish and maintain effective working relationships with students, faculty, staff, correctional partners, and external agencies.
Communicate effectively and professionally with diverse populations.
Organize and prioritize multiple assignments, deadlines, and operational responsibilities.
Exercise sound judgment, discretion, and confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
Adapt to changing procedures, regulations, technology, and student service needs.
Work independently within established guidelines and collaboratively as part of a team.
FLSA Non-Exempt
Classified – CSEA
Date Modified: 8/21/2026
Categorical (grant) Funded – employment contingent on continued funding
Ability to obtain and maintain clearance to enter correctional institutions.
Demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students.
